identity.description: An attacker uses a legitimate Windows binary (e.g., powershell.exe) to execute a command that connects to a rare external IP address, triggering a behavioral anomaly detection. Cortex should detect this network connection and the use of a LOLBIN.

biocs.name: LOLBIN Process with Rare Network Connection
biocs.description: Detection of a LOLBIN process initiating a network connection to an IP address not commonly seen in the environment.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('powershell.exe', 'wmic.exe', 'rundll32.exe')
| filter action_remote_ip not in (known_ips)
| filter action_remote_ip != '127.0.0.1'
| filter action_remote_ip != '::1'
| filter dst_port = 80 or dst_port = 443
